scope: Nikon Z8 pixel-shift sequence identity, frame grouping, and NEFX metadata

constructor_observations.limitation: Constructor writes alone do not establish trailing alignment padding.

constructor_observations.tree_sentinel: At RVA 0xa72f, the allocated object's pointer fields at 0x00, 0x08, and 0x10 reference itself; bytes 0x18 and 0x19 are set to 1.

constructor_observations.limitation: Field meanings and ownership are not established by constructors alone.

call_site_observations.confirmed: A loop constructs CNkvPixelShiftShootingInfoData elements and advances source and destination pointers by 0x20 bytes per element.
call_site_observations.implication: The object representation used by this loop has a 0x20-byte stride; this does not reveal frame ordering.

call_site_observations.confirmed: A default CNkvPixelShiftShootingInfoData is constructed before a record is populated and inserted into a container.
call_site_observations.implication: The class is part of Polaris metadata/container processing.

call_site_observations.confirmed: A CNkvPixelShiftShootingInfoData copy operation is used while growing or relocating a container.
call_site_observations.implication: The observed copies are container mechanics, not proof of capture sequence order.

confirmed: The outer ordered tree is keyed by the sixth argument, a 32-bit value read from CNkvImagePropertyData offset 0x280 by the caller.
The nested ordered tree is keyed by the seventh argument, a 32-bit value read from CNkvImagePropertyData offset 0x284 by the caller.
Each inner record holds a 64-bit input item identifier followed by an object copied through the CNkvFilePath copy constructor.
If both the outer group key and inner frame key already exist, the function returns at RVAs 0x1f5a17 through 0x1f5a1a before changing the existing record; first occurrence wins.
ShootingInfoData offset 0x10 is initialized to the outer key if it was zero; offset 0x14 receives metadata-object offset 0x270 if zero; offset 0x18 receives metadata-object offset 0x274 if zero.
At RVAs 0x1f5ba1 through 0x1f5bb6, equality between the signed 32-bit offset-0x18 value and the inner tree's 64-bit item count sets the offset-0x1c byte to 1.
grouping_function.limitation: These facts recover the NX Studio consumer behavior. They do not establish that burst identity is globally unique across cameras, cards, directory rollovers, or later sessions.

group_and_frame_key.group_key: little-endian uint32 from returned block bytes 4..7 to CNkvImagePropertyData+0x280
group_and_frame_key.frame_key: little-endian uint32 from returned block bytes 8..11 to CNkvImagePropertyData+0x284
group_and_frame_key.missing_or_failed_read: Both destination fields are initialized to zero at RVA 0x22c37e.

mode_and_expected_count.destinations: Mode is stored at CNkvImagePropertyData+0x270; expected frame count is stored at +0x274. Missing, failed, or unrecognized data leaves zero values.

metadata_key_dataflow.relationship_to_file_tags: The key suffix 0x0056, 16-byte length, and byte offsets align with ExifTool MakerNote 0x0056. The metadata service's exact raw-file-to-returned-block transformation has not been traced, so vendor returned-buffer offsets are distinguished from confirmed raw-file offsets.

input_array_order.confirmed: The function walks the inner tree in ascending unsigned 32-bit key order, obtains each CNkvFilePath full path through CNkvStringData::GetPtrUtf8, and appends that UTF-8 pointer to the input array supplied to PixelShiftCombine. There is no filename comparison in this path-array construction.
input_array_order.implication: PixelShiftCombine array index zero corresponds to the smallest supplied frame key, not inherently to a hardcoded zero- or one-based capture index. The frame key's starting value still requires authentic samples.

source_metadata_contract.camera_scope: LibRaw gates this parser on Nikon Z-series models; ExifTool's table comment names Z8/Z9.

fields.name: FirmwareVersion56
fields.encoding: ASCII string in ExifTool; four decimal digits in LibRaw

fields.name: BurstIdentityPacked
fields.status: packed; decoded by ExifTool masks below with inherited byte order

fields.name: BurstFlag
fields.encoding: ExifTool default int8u; nonzero enables the named Burst fields

fields.name: BurstShotNumber
fields.encoding: ExifTool int32u with inherited byte order

fields.name: PixelShiftActive
fields.encoding: ExifTool default int8u; 0 maps to No and 1 to Yes

source_metadata_contract.LibRaw_limitations: LibRaw stores only bytes 4-5 as a little-endian gid and byte 8 as fnum. These are narrower than ExifTool's packed 32-bit identity and shot-number fields, and must not be treated as a sufficient unique sequence identity.

confirmed: Nikon Z-series data whose packed size matches the three-color 14-bit formula selects nikon_14bit_load_raw().
The three-color branch sets filters to 0, indicating no Bayer CFA in the decoded NEFX image.
The loader unpacks 21 packed bytes into twelve 14-bit channel samples stored as uint16: four pixels with three channels each.
nefx_decode_contract.formula_as_implemented: ceilf(float(raw_width * 21 / 4) / 16.f) * 16 * raw_height; raw_width * 21 / 4 uses integer division before the float conversion
nefx_decode_contract.limitation: This identifies a three-channel NEFX decode path; it does not define NEFX metadata tags, source frame ordering, or Nikon's numerical merge algorithm.

confirmed: PixelShiftCombine.dll's 32-input dispatch groups caller-array positions as [0..3,16..19], [4..7,20..23], [8..11,24..27], and [12..15,28..31] for four eight-input merge calls; see nx-studio-1.10.1-windows.json.

Polaris builds the caller's input array in ascending unsigned 32-bit frame-key order using returned metadata key 0x80056 bytes 8..11. Array positions still do not establish spatial phase or whether real capture numbering begins at zero or one.

ExifTool interprets MakerNote 0x0056 as burst identity, shot number, and a pixel-shift-active flag. This is source-level evidence; no genuine pixel-shift sequence has validated the complete grouping contract.
unknown: The complete mapping from frame identity to sensor spatial phase is not established.
No authentic Z8 pixel-shift NEF sequence or NX Studio NEFX output is available for correlation.
No filename ordering rule is proven; nxc must not infer ordering from lexicographic names or adjacent timestamps alone.

CNkvPixelShiftShootingInfoData offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, and 0x1c now have dataflow meanings: group key, mode, expected frame count, and completeness flag. Other CNkvPixelShiftData fields remain unresolved.
The exact raw-file-to-vendor-metadata-block transformation for 0x80056 and 0x8005e remains unresolved.
NEFX container tag semantics and metadata preservation rules remain unresolved.
